events.text: Hey. I was thinking about that little adventure you mentioned yesterday, the one where nothing went according to plan but you somehow came home with a better story. Really? Tell me the part you left out, especially the moment when you realized you would have to improvise instead of following the perfectly sensible plan you had prepared. Oh. That explains the grin. I had a feeling there was more to it. Now give me a second to be impressed before I start teasing you about your definition of careful.

trialPassage.label: S06 · Tiny opening, longer follow-up
trialPassage.description: Alternates short and long sentences to expose early starvation and phrase seams.
trialPassage.text: Hey. I was thinking about that little adventure you mentioned yesterday, the one where nothing went according to plan but you somehow came home with a better story. Really? Tell me the part you left out, especially the moment when you realized you would have to improvise instead of following the perfectly sensible plan you had prepared. Oh. That explains the grin. I had a feeling there was more to it. Now give me a second to be impressed before I start teasing you about your definition of careful.

rows.label: Browser audio setup
rows.details: Audio context creation and resume after pressing Start.

rows.label: Kokoro service boot
rows.details: Outside this test. Docker/model boot is not started or timed by the page.

rows.label: Server preparation
rows.details: Streaming worker, ownership lock and opening request preparation.

rows.label: Kokoro request startup
rows.details: Request send through response headers; includes provider readiness/validation, not isolated model boot.

rows.label: Kokoro generation → first bytes
rows.details: Includes text/phoneme processing, synthesis, encoding and first-byte delivery; pure inference is not separately exposed.

rows.label: First packet receipt & decoding
rows.details: Remaining JSON/PCM transfer, frame parsing, base64 decoding and validation.

rows.label: Rhubarb before first playback
rows.details: Region WAV/transcript preparation, recognizer process and cue parsing. Stops counting at the region that releases playback.

rows.label: Waiting for enough aligned audio
rows.details: Waiting for more input/context, preparing regions and assembling results, excluding Rhubarb intervals.

rows.label: Browser delivery & scheduling
rows.details: Initial response delivery, aligned-region transfer/decoding and audio output scheduling. Residual, not a network-only measurement.

startupTiming.measurement: Click to estimated first Web Audio output. Active stage timers are estimates; completed durations use monotonic milestones.
startupTiming.overlap: Only the startup path is counted. Kokoro continues generating while Rhubarb works; later work is excluded.
